## States

- default shell
- menu open
- dialog overlay

## Controls

- Alt+F opens the File menu
- Ctrl+K opens the command palette
- Esc closes the active overlay

## Edge cases

- narrow panes keep title and status bars visible
- overlay focus returns to the originating pane
